source_basis: Public method principles and observed V7 interference; no task-specific answers.

skill.title: annual_log
skill.guidance: For continuously compounded annual growth, use ln(end/start)/(end_year-start_year). Count elapsed intervals, not inclusive observations. Keep the same category at both endpoints.

skill.title: compound_growth
skill.guidance: CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed_intervals)-1. A growth factor is 1+CAGR. Use matching endpoint categories; convert to percent only when requested.

skill.title: share_change
skill.guidance: For a change in share, pair each part with its own period's total: 100*(part2/total2-part1/total1) gives percentage points. Take abs only if requested; this is not relative percent growth.

skill.title: midpoint_difference
skill.guidance: For midpoint-normalized difference use the midpoint, not a base denominator. This calculator uses absolute difference; use Python for signed forms. Percent output scales by 100.

skill.title: paired_series
skill.goal: Align observations before a paired statistic
skill.guidance: Align paired series by identical observation periods. Pearson correlation is not regression slope. For regression, preserve the named predictor and response; do not silently drop a missing period.

skill.title: monthly_total
skill.goal: Aggregate calendar months without double counting
skill.guidance: For an annual total from monthly rows, use each requested calendar month once. Exclude fiscal-year, year-to-date and quarterly subtotals; preserve the requested category and unit.
